title: What’s the Invisible Shield of Earth?

segments.text: Did you know Earth’s magnetic field keeps us safe?
It’s made by electric currents in molten iron and nickel swirling in the outer core.
Those currents push back the Sun’s charged particles.
The field stretches into space, forming the magnetosphere.
The magnetosphere stops solar wind from reaching our atmosphere.
If it vanished, charged particles would strip the upper layers, including ozone.
It also blocks cosmic rays from outside our Solar System.
The shield is a natural geodynamo, not a man‑made device.
Without it, the wind would erode the atmosphere.
The magnetosphere is the invisible shield of Earth.
